info.description: A fast web fuzzer written in Go.

parameters.name: URL
parameters.description: Target URL.

parameters.name: Method
parameters.description: HTTP method to use.

parameters.name: POST Data
parameters.description: POST data.

parameters.name: Cookie
parameters.description: Cookie data "NAME1=VALUE1; NAME2=VALUE2" for copy as curl functionality.

parameters.name: Header
parameters.description: Header "Name: Value", separated by colon. Multiple -H flags are accepted.

parameters.name: Client Certificate
parameters.description: Client cert for authentication. Client key needs to be defined as well.

parameters.name: Client Key
parameters.description: Client key for authentication. Client certificate needs to be defined as well.

parameters.name: Proxy
parameters.description: Proxy URL (SOCKS5 or HTTP). For example: http://127.0.0.1:8080 or socks5://127.0.0.1:8080.

parameters.name: Replay Proxy
parameters.description: Replay matched requests using this proxy.

parameters.name: Follow Redirects
parameters.description: Follow redirects.

parameters.name: Timeout
parameters.description: HTTP request timeout in seconds.

parameters.name: HTTP2
parameters.description: Use HTTP2 protocol.

parameters.name: SNI
parameters.description: Target TLS SNI, does not support FUZZ keyword.

parameters.name: Raw
parameters.description: Do not encode URI.

parameters.name: Ignore Body
parameters.description: Do not fetch the response content.

parameters.name: Recursion
parameters.description: Scan recursively. Only FUZZ keyword is supported, and URL must end in it.

parameters.name: Recursion Depth
parameters.description: Maximum recursion depth.

parameters.name: Recursion Strategy
parameters.description: Recursion strategy.

parameters.name: Threads
parameters.description: Number of concurrent threads.

parameters.name: Rate
parameters.description: Rate of requests per second.

parameters.name: Delay
parameters.description: Seconds of delay between requests, or a range of random delay. For example "0.1" or "0.1-2.0".

parameters.name: Max Time
parameters.description: Maximum running time in seconds for entire process.

parameters.name: Max Time Per Job
parameters.description: Maximum running time in seconds per job.

parameters.name: Auto-Calibrate
parameters.description: Automatically calibrate filtering options.

parameters.name: Auto-Calibrate String
parameters.description: Custom auto-calibration string. Can be used multiple times. Implies -ac.

parameters.name: Auto-Calibrate Per Host
parameters.description: Per host autocalibration.

parameters.name: Auto-Calibrate Keyword
parameters.description: Autocalibration keyword.

parameters.name: Auto-Calibrate Strategy
parameters.description: Custom auto-calibration strategies. Can be used multiple times. Implies -ac.

parameters.name: Stop on All Errors
parameters.description: Stop on all error cases. Implies -sf and -se.

parameters.name: Stop on Spurious Errors
parameters.description: Stop on spurious errors.

parameters.name: Stop on Forbidden
parameters.description: Stop when > 95% of responses return 403 Forbidden.

parameters.name: Scrapers
parameters.description: Active scraper groups.

parameters.name: Scraper File
parameters.description: Custom scraper file path.

parameters.name: Colorize
parameters.description: Colorize output.

parameters.name: Silent
parameters.description: Do not print additional information (silent mode).

parameters.name: Verbose
parameters.description: Verbose output, printing full URL and redirect location with the results.

parameters.name: JSON Output
parameters.description: JSON output, printing newline-delimited JSON records.

parameters.name: Config File
parameters.description: Load configuration from a file.

parameters.name: Search
parameters.description: Search for a FFUFHASH payload from ffuf history.

parameters.name: Non-Interactive
parameters.description: Disable the interactive console functionality.

parameters.name: Version
parameters.description: Show version information.

parameters.name: Match Codes
parameters.description: Match HTTP status codes, or "all" for everything.

parameters.name: Match Size
parameters.description: Match HTTP response size.

parameters.name: Match Lines
parameters.description: Match amount of lines in response.

parameters.name: Match Words
parameters.description: Match amount of words in response.

parameters.name: Match Time
parameters.description: Match how many milliseconds to the first response byte, either greater or less than. E.g. >100 or <100.

parameters.name: Match Regexp
parameters.description: Match regexp.

parameters.name: Match Mode
parameters.description: Matcher set operator.

parameters.name: Filter Codes
parameters.description: Filter HTTP status codes from response. Comma separated list of codes and ranges.

parameters.name: Filter Size
parameters.description: Filter HTTP response size. Comma separated list of sizes and ranges.

parameters.name: Filter Lines
parameters.description: Filter by amount of lines in response. Comma separated list of line counts and ranges.

parameters.name: Filter Words
parameters.description: Filter by amount of words in response. Comma separated list of word counts and ranges.

parameters.name: Filter Time
parameters.description: Filter by number of milliseconds to the first response byte, either greater or less than. E.g. >100 or <100.

parameters.name: Filter Regexp
parameters.description: Filter regexp.

parameters.name: Filter Mode
parameters.description: Filter set operator.

parameters.name: Wordlist
parameters.description: Wordlist file path and (optional) keyword separated by colon. E.g. '/path/to/wordlist:KEYWORD'.

parameters.name: Extensions
parameters.description: Comma separated list of extensions. Extends FUZZ keyword.

parameters.name: DirSearch Compatibility
parameters.description: DirSearch wordlist compatibility mode. Used in conjunction with -e flag.

parameters.name: Mode
parameters.description: Multi-wordlist operation mode.

parameters.name: Encoders
parameters.description: Encoders for keywords, e.g. 'FUZZ:urlencode b64encode'.

parameters.name: Ignore Comments
parameters.description: Ignore wordlist comments.

parameters.name: Request File
parameters.description: File containing the raw HTTP request.

parameters.name: Request Protocol
parameters.description: Protocol to use along with raw request.

parameters.name: Input Command
parameters.description: Command producing the input. --input-num is required when using this method. Overrides -w.

parameters.name: Input Number
parameters.description: Number of inputs to test. Used in conjunction with --input-cmd.

parameters.name: Input Shell
parameters.description: Shell to be used for running command.

parameters.name: Output File
parameters.description: Write output to file.

parameters.name: Output Format
parameters.description: Output file format.

parameters.name: Output Directory
parameters.description: Directory path to store matched results to.

parameters.name: No Empty Output
parameters.description: Don't create the output file if we don't have results.

parameters.name: Debug Log
parameters.description: Write all of the internal logging to the specified file.
